name: blast-shield
description: Holds risky shell commands (rm, git reset/clean/force-push, kubectl, terraform, docker, SQL and more) and payment tool calls, shows what they would change, and runs them only on your say-so.

spendPatterns.title: Spend: tool name patterns
spendPatterns.description: Words that mark an MCP tool as a payment, separated by commas. A tool matches when a word of its name (after mcp__<server>__) is one of these or its plural. Tools whose name starts with list, get, retrieve and similar read verbs never match.

dailyAllowance.title: Spend: daily allowance
dailyAllowance.description: Payments under this total per day (in major units, e.g. 20 = 20.00) go through without a hold and are still logged. 0 holds every payment.

allowanceCurrency.title: Spend: allowance currency
allowanceCurrency.description: The currency of the daily allowance, as a code like usd. A payment in another currency, or with none, is held.

minorUnitServers.title: Spend: servers that send cents
minorUnitServers.description: MCP servers whose bare amount field is in minor units (2000 means 20.00), separated by commas, named as their tools name them: stripe for mcp__stripe__create_refund. Every other server's bare amount is read as major units, which over-counts a cents-based server rather than under-counting. Fields named for cents are always minor units.

payeeAllowlist.title: Spend: payee allowlist
payeeAllowlist.description: Payees the allowance may pay, separated by commas (an account id, customer id or email, as the tool names it). Empty allows any payee under the allowance. A payee outside the list is always held.
